text: 据韩联社报道，在美国中期选举后，围绕AI数据中心监管的担忧凸显并导致股市震荡的背景下，韩国企划财政部与半导体专家举行座谈，就相关产业动向及未来需求前景进行了检查。与会者综合评估认为，考虑到主要AI企业大规模投资的进展情况和未来计划，以及智能体AI普及带来的半导体需求扩大等因素，AI与半导体产业的中长期增长预期依然有效。他们研判称，尽管金融市场存在部分担忧，但目前尚未监测到会导致AI投资或半导体需求萎缩的明显信号。此外，考虑到韩国国内半导体企业长期供应合同的扩大等因素，预计短期内需求基础将保持稳定。
text_en: According to Yonhap, after the US midterm elections, with concerns over AI data center regulation coming to the fore and roiling stock markets, South Korea's Ministry of Economy and Finance held a meeting with semiconductor experts to review industry trends and future demand prospects. Participants assessed that, considering the progress and future plans of large-scale investment by major AI companies, as well as the expansion of semiconductor demand brought by the spread of agentic AI, the medium- and long-term growth expectations for the AI and semiconductor industries remain valid. They judged that despite some concerns in financial markets, no clear signals have been monitored that would cause AI investment or semiconductor demand to shrink. In addition, considering factors such as the expansion of long-term supply contracts by South Korean semiconductor companies, the demand base is expected to remain stable in the short term.
